deviations.reason: Shared production assets remain a Phase B dependency; Phase A uses engine-native primitives only.

Havok Physics V2 owns the static arena/environment proof while player and enemy locomotion use a thin deterministic game-specific kinematic layer in the unobstructed arena. This avoids adding a heavier controller abstraction without collision evidence requiring one.
Enemy navigation uses direct steering in the unobstructed arena; Recast is deferred until obstacle/pathfinding evidence requires it.
Hosted stable Chrome exposed navigator.gpu but Babylon selected the WebGL2 fallback path during successful tracer and full Phase A execution. Real-device backend evidence remains required later.
